message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large green block letters across the top. The central figure is a man wearing glasses, a black suit, a white shirt, a green tie, and a black peci cap. He holds his right hand to his temple.

Surrounding his head are multiple floating, caricatured versions of a different man's face, shown with wide eyes and open-mouthed grins. These smaller heads are various sizes and appear to float within transparent bubbles and near green star shapes. The background is a pale green.

Text at the top reads "MAIN POLITIK DI RUMAH TUHAN" and "JALAN DI TEMPAT BLOK MASELA". To the right, large black text reads "SUAP TUJUH KELILING". Below this, smaller text describes alleged position buying within the Ministry of Religious Affairs. A barcode and technical details are in the bottom left, including the date "25-31 MARET 2019" and price "RP 45.000". The man's name, "LUKMAN HAKIM SAIFUDDIN," is highlighted in green text near the bottom right.
